title.narrative: Construction and equipping of the Dr. Abdullah bin Abdulaziz Al-Rabeeah and his parents and descendants healthcare center and its annexes in Damascus Governorate, Syrian Arab Republic

description.narrative: 1. Providing Basic Healthcare: After the prolonged conflict, many citizens in Damascus lost access to adequate healthcare. A new health center will help provide medical services to the local community, including primary medical treatment, emergency care, and treatment for chronic diseases.2. Enhancing Health Security: By providing modern medical facilities, it is ensured that the population can access necessary healthcare during times of crisis and potential epidemics.3. Supporting Vulnerable Groups: The health center is a vital means of supporting vulnerable groups such as women, children, and the elderly, who may face greater challenges in accessing treatment due to economic or social circumstances.4. Achieving Social Stability: The presence of a health center providing medical services will enhance the stability of the local community and contribute to alleviating human suffering. This center can serve as a platform for building trust between the local community and the new authorities in this new phase of Syria's history. 5. Infrastructure Reconstruction: The health center project will bolster the city's basic infrastructure reconstruction and contribute to the rehabilitation of war-affected areas. 6. Job Creation: The construction and operation of a health center and its associated facilities, including a mosque and shops, will create job opportunities for local residents in construction, healthcare, management, maintenance, and commerce, thus stimulating the local economy. 7. Contribution to a Sustainable Healthcare System: By providing advanced medical services, this center can be part of developing a sustainable healthcare system that achieves future health independence.

Construction and equipping of a health center and its annexes to rehabilitate essential health services that have been severely damaged, to provide basic medical services to the conflict-affected local community, and to improve access to healthcare, especially for vulnerable groups. This will contribute to strengthening health and social stability, help rebuild the city's health infrastructure, enhance the well-being of the population, and contribute to the sustainability of the health system in the future.

• A healthcare center ready to provide essential services to citizens in Damascus. • Other facilities, such as the mosque and its annexes, ready to provide additional services to center patients and the surrounding community. • Shops on the center's site ready for investment to ensure the sustainability of the necessary funding for the center's operation. • Provision of the necessary medical equipment to provide primary healthcare and dialysis services. • Provision of the necessary non-medical equipment for the center's healthcare staff to provide the required services.
